title: Rasmalai cake near Schofields or Box Hill? 100% eggless, from Riverstone
summary: Rasmalai cake without egg, for a family that never has to ask. Every cake at Num Num's Riverstone is 100% eggless, and Rasmalai is one of our 15 flavours. Cardamom, saffron and milk in the sponge, not a vanilla cake with a label on it. Diwali is 8 November, so order by Thursday 5 November for the weekend. 48-hour notice, fresh to order. Collect from Shop 8, Riverstone Shopping Centre, with free parking. Schofields, Box Hill, Marsden Park and Vineyard families order on WhatsApp +61 425 697 725.
